scope: Laphroaig 10 Year Old Cask Strength batches 4 and 5 only. Ready entries are saved progressively. Runtime, matching, prices and image manifests remain outside this research task.
sourcePolicy: Exact-batch producer, retailer or named reviewer notes only; reviewer and retailer notes must not be represented as official producer notes. Photographs are downloaded and visually checked before being marked verified.

sources.evidence: Exact Batch 004 page confirms ten years, January 2012, 58.3%, 70cl and distillery bottling. The downloaded photograph independently shows Batch 004, JAN.12, 58.3%, 10 Years Old and 700ml / 70cl.

Thijs Klaverstijn's 17 December 2017 review explicitly identifies the ten-year-old Batch 004 at 58.3%. Nose combines smoke, farm and coast with orange, strawberry and brown sugar. Sweet cereal arrival becomes ashy with peat, tar, a little rubber and cloves; the finish retains peat and tar with some dryness.

entries.proposedDescription: 2012년 1월 병입된 58.3%의 10년 캐스크 스트렝스 배치. 연기와 해안의 기운에 과일·흑설탕의 단맛이 겹치고, 재와 타르를 닮은 피트 풍미로 이어진다.

proposedNotes.nose: 연기와 농가를 떠올리는 향, 해안의 기운에 오렌지와 딸기, 은은한 흑설탕의 단향이 겹친다.
proposedNotes.palate: 달콤한 시리얼로 시작해 재와 피트, 타르가 두드러지며 약간의 고무와 정향이 느껴진다.
proposedNotes.finish: 피트와 타르의 여운이 남으며 약간 드라이하게 마무리된다.

notesProvenance.scope: Concise Korean paraphrase of the named reviewer's exact 58.3% Batch 004 nose, taste and finish. These are personal reviewer notes, not producer notes. The reviewer's initial blind-tasting guess of a sherry-matured Caol Ila is not treated as product identity or maturation evidence.

photoCandidates.labelEvidence: Real bottle and tube photograph on white. Bottle label visibly reads Batch 004, JAN.12, 58.3%, 10 Years Old and 700ml / 70cl. Tube also shows 004, 58.3% and ten years; its date is partly obscured by the bottle.

cautions: This entry represents the 58.3% / 700ml bottling. Batch 004 also exists at 58.6% / 750ml; notes or images of that variant must not be silently substituted.
Tasting notes are the named reviewer's impressions and are not officially verified producer notes.

variantCautionSources.evidence: Retailer separately lists Batch 004, January 2012, 58.6% and 750ml. Used only to document why that variant must be kept separate; no facts, notes or photograph from it are substituted into this 58.3% / 700ml entry.

sources.evidence: Exact Batch 005 lot identifies ten years, February 2013, 57.2% and 70cl. Its downloaded photograph independently shows 005, FEB 13, Aged 10 Years, 57.2% and 70cl / 700ml.

The exact Batch 5 page identifies ten years, February 2013 and 57.2%. Paul Belbusti's tasting note emphasizes intense smoky peat, hearth smoke, sweet cinnamon, iodine, smoked fish and meat, lemon peel and a long smoky finish. Dried fruit and nuts emerge after adding water.

entries.proposedDescription: 2013년 2월 병입된 57.2%의 10년 캐스크 스트렝스 배치. 강렬한 피트 연기에 달콤한 계피와 요오드, 훈연 생선·고기와 레몬 껍질의 풍미가 겹친다.

proposedNotes.nose: 짙은 연기를 동반한 강렬한 피트 향이 올라온다.
proposedNotes.palate: 장작불과 달콤한 계피, 요오드, 훈연 생선과 고기, 산뜻한 레몬 껍질이 겹친다. 물을 더하면 건과일과 견과류가 드러난다.

notesProvenance.scope: Concise Korean paraphrase of the named reviewer's tasting note on the exact 57.2% Batch 5 page. These are reviewer notes, not producer notes. The single paragraph is organized into nose, palate and finish; its explicit water-addition condition is retained for dried fruit and nuts.

photoCandidates.labelEvidence: Real bottle and tube photograph on white with the auction watermark. Both show Batch 005, FEB 13, Aged 10 Years and 57.2%; bottle shows 70cl and tube shows 70cl / 700ml.

cautions: Tasting notes are the named reviewer's impressions and are not officially verified producer notes.
Dried fruit and nuts are specifically water-added impressions in the source; this condition must remain in the notes.
